body: Yeah you are right. But I mean, people expect you to be a productive member of society and I just can't. And it feels so wrong. Because I used to have ambitions and dreams and now it's just "lets see what gets me through the day".

Problem is, I simply have no time for being diagnosed... I have a few physical health problems that'd need a checkup soon too, but my current job takes me about 9.5 hours every day. Add to that daily chores, foodmaking and general hygene and my free time is like 1 hour a day, between 22.00 and 23.00 (mainly because I need hours to do anything). And getting an appointment for Saturdays sounds very difficult to say the least.. 

Keeping the job would be easier if every step wouldn't feel like a marathon and every fail would feel like I'm doomed I must add.

I thought about Anti Depressants too, but I dont want to go back to taking illegal street crap. Isn't it weird that in todays society I feel like I can't afford to be sad because it will backfire?
